purpose: Select the strongest manuscript-level scientific claim from already executed source-verified Q1–Q4; not to retroactively replace any preregistered primary estimand.

primary_manuscript_hypothesis.question: Does an observed A-first temporal response prove that A evolution is necessary for subsequent floral-investment decline under pollinator limitation?
primary_manuscript_hypothesis.claim: In a pollen-limited finite-diploid Model 3, reproductive assurance A may cross a sustained response threshold before investment I declines; nevertheless, I can decline when A evolution is blocked at nonzero A=0.5. Temporal precedence therefore does not establish evolutionary necessity within this model.

fixed_A_counterexample.new_founder_support: 4/4 setting means and 8/8 founder-specific fixed-A far-minus-near means negative in each setting; retrospective archive readback, not new prospective primary test

interpretation_limits: Observed A-first and fixed-A counterexample came from different registered source cohorts, not exact path-matched 51 interventions.
A evolution was disabled, not self-fertilization; expressed A remained 0.5.
Exhibiting counterexamples refutes a universal prerequisite claim in the tested model, but does not prove every real species or island evolves independently of assurance.
Neither the first mutational event nor a natural genetic/evolutionary rescue path was inferred from the 0.05/20-census crossing metric.

supporting_logic.claim: Without mutation at I and seed immigration, the inherited I-allele support S(t+1) is a subset of S(t); losing needed low-I alleles can close a specified future 0.05 investment decline before complete I fixation.
supporting_logic.proof_scope: No I mutation and no immigrant I alleles; not universal for positive mutation/immigration.

supporting_logic.claim: Allowing A to evolve can change the near/far floral-investment divergence, but the four-setting generality of the E-minus-F compression did not transport fully to fresh founders (direct A-cost unresolved).

supporting_logic.study_scope: One new approved finite Model 3 campaign, eight founder labels crossed with eight visitor-history labels, two artificial pollen-limited environments, three I-genotype policies: 384 paths each with 200 updates.
supporting_logic.registered_joint_gate: BOTH co-primary adjusted intervals must exclude zero
interpretation_limits: Do not claim significance or a demonstrated zero effect; both adjusted intervals straddle zero.
The genetically unreachable 0/64 arms are mathematically engineered negative controls, not an independent discovered selection mechanism.
Carrier number affects standing allele frequencies, genotype distribution and genetic variance jointly; variance-specific mediation not identified.
No outcome-driven added seeds, power rescue, thresholds or unregistered new co-primary inference.

supporting_logic.claim: Conditional genotype-density predictions of A-first did not occur as A-first in most matched finite Model 3 paths (3/32 and 2/32 in two contexts) despite occupancy.
supporting_logic.limits: Density is not exact finite-ABM ensemble expectation; differs in individual self-pollen exclusion; cannot uniquely attribute mismatch to genetic drift or allele loss from another source cohort.
Future A evolvability continues; no spontaneous A-first order-mediated survival rescue identified.

paper_evidence_layers.interpretation: Source-confirmed within declared model/counterfactual/theorem; not global natural-island law
Supported conditional model-setting effects with limited transport
Observed heterogeneity / incomplete causal attribution / prospectively inconclusive contrast

manuscript_decision.center: Precedence is not evolutionary necessity; expected response direction, genetic reachability, realized path and persistence are distinct model-dependent propositions.
manuscript_decision.not_claim: Carrier count determines direction of evolution or initial standing variation solely drives the order.
manuscript_decision.existing_paper_state: single active unsubmitted Ecology Letters Letter; preserve Q1-Q4 results and original figures

further_work_status: No additional biological cohorts authorized or necessary to finalize this editorial decision; future confirmation of the inconclusive carrier effect would need an independently justified and preregistered new study rather than ad hoc seed expansion.
